description:
End a call you placed. In an open conversation `goodbye` is spoken
    first; leave it empty to just hang up. A call that already ended reports
    its final status.

call_id.description: The call_id from the call or play_audio result.
call_id.title: Call Id

goodbye.description: Spoken before the line drops in an open conversation, e.g. "Thanks, I'll get on it." Empty just hangs up.
goodbye.title: Goodbye

session_token.description: The session_token from an earlier result. It keeps every call and text in one thread on their phone.
session_token.title: Session Token

name: hang_up

open.description: Always false: the line is down.
open.title: Open

status.description: "ended", or "hanging_up" while the goodbye is spoken.
status.title: Status

title: Hang up
